what: Man charged with murder and sexual assault of 5-year-old Australian girl

clean_source_blocks.text: The girl's death sparked an outbreak of violence in the central Australian town from where she disappeared.
A man has been charged with murder and two counts of sexual assault following the death of a five-year-old girl in Australia.
Jefferson Lewis, 47, was charged with her murder on Saturday night and has been scheduled to appear in a Darwin court on Tuesday.
Lewis was reportedly attacked in the central Australian town before he was arrested on Thursday.
